description: What changed in a git repository on disk: commits, tags, diffs, files and code search, through a fixed set of read-only git commands. Off until an environment sets it up.

repo.description: The repository folder, absolute or relative to the workspace (a clone you keep up to date)

ref.description: The branch, tag or commit deployed in this environment; history is read from it (e.g. main, release/2.14, v2.14.0)

log.description: Commits of the repository before an incident: who changed what and when, newest first, with the files they touched. Use it to see what changed before a problem started. Read-only.

since.description: Only commits after this time, ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-10-07T09:00:00Z)

until.description: Only commits before this time, ISO 8601

path.description: Only commits touching this file or folder, e.g. src/worker

author.description: Part of the author name or email

message.description: Text to find in the commit message

limit.description: Most commits to return, up to 100

show.description: One commit in full: author, time, message and the files it changed with their size. Read-only.

commit.description: A commit hash, tag or branch name

diff.description: The changes of one file or folder between two commits, tags or branches, as a patch (cut when long). Read-only.

from.description: The older commit, tag or branch, e.g. v2.13.2

path.description: The file or folder to compare, e.g. src/worker/confirm.js

grep.description: Search the code of the repository at the deployed ref for a text (not a regex): where a message, an error or a setting is defined. Read-only.

text.description: The text to find, e.g. queue full

path.description: Only under this folder, e.g. src

fileAt.description: Read one file of the repository as it is at a commit, tag or branch, cut when long. Read-only.

ref.description: Commit, tag or branch (default: the environment's ref)

tags.description: The tags of the repository with their dates: which release shipped when, to match a release to the commits before it. Read-only.

pattern.description: Tag name pattern, e.g. v2.* (letters, digits, . - _ *)

limit.description: Most tags to return, up to 100
